info.title: Chat Config API
info.description: Provides methods for configuring chat for an apiSpace

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

get.summary: Retrieves the chat configuration for an apiSpace

ETag.description: A unique value representing the version of the configuration, optionally used for optimistic concurrency control on PUT and DELETE

Last-Modified.description: The date the team was last updated in ISO 8601 format

get.summary: Retrieves the members of a team

ETag.description: A unique value representing the version of the configuration, optionally used for optimistic concurrency control on PUT and DELETE

Last-Modified.description: The date the team was last updated in ISO 8601 format

delete.summary: Removes the config for a team

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: An optional ETag for optimistic concurrency control

200.description: The config was removed for the team

404.description: The team was not found, or did not have any config already

412.description: The ETag supplied did not match, another update may have taken place

put.summary: Update the App Messaging config for a team

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: An optional ETag for optimistic concurrency control

requestBody.description: The App Messaging config to update for the team

ETag.description: A unique value representing the version of the configuration, optionally used for optimistic concurrency control on PUT and DELETE

Last-Modified.description: The date the configuration was last updated in ISO 8601 format

412.description: The ETag supplied did not match, another update may have taken place

delete.summary: Removes the App Messaging config for a team

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: An optional ETag for optimistic concurrency control

200.description: The App Messaging config was removed for the team

404.description: The team was not found, or did not have any config already

412.description: The ETag supplied did not match, another update may have taken place

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: An optional ETag for optimistic concurrency control

requestBody.description: The settings to update for the team

delete.summary: Removes the settings for a team

parameters.name: if-match
parameters.description: An optional ETag for optimistic concurrency control

200.description: The general settings were removed for the team

404.description: The team was not found, or did not have any config already

412.description: The ETag supplied did not match, another update may have taken place
